questions: What is the current applicable Tank 1 high-level setpoint: 0.78 m or 0.80 m?
What is the current applicable wait after Tank 1 reaches its low-level limit: 10 s or 12 s?
What is the current applicable inter-cycle wait after Tank 2 reaches its low-level limit: 10 s or 8 s?
During SHUT, does the controller open V2 and V3 while inhibiting V1, or close all valves immediately?
Is the observed operator note at 700 s (XV-102 and XV-101 open) a recording error, a lamp/alias mismatch, or evidence of different SHUT logic than TP17/URS?

answers.clarify_shut_valve_behavior: Open V2 and V3 while inhibiting V1 until both tanks are at or below low level, then close all valves and return to IDLE
answers.clarify_operator_shut_observation: Recording error or lamp/alias mismatch; retain TP17/URS SHUT behavior as governing pending confirmation
